title: Arbitrary base change for smooth ambient duality
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $N\geq1$ satisfy $NA=0$, with $N$ invertible on the schemes in question, as in [thm-asd-smooth-tensor]. All categories are the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], not completed or constructible categories. For a morphism $v$, write $v^*$ for exact etale inverse image on constant-coefficient module sheaves, extended degreewise to complexes. Let $f:X\to S$ be smooth, separated, compactifiable and of pure relative dimension $d$, between Noetherian schemes, as in [thm-asd-smooth-tensor]. Let $g:S'\to S$ be any morphism of Noetherian schemes, and put $X'=X\times_S S'$, with projections $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$. Use $Rf_!$ of [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and its right adjoint $f^\times$ of [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and similarly for $f'$. The canonical morphism $\beta_{f,g,K}:g'^*f^\times K\to f'^\times g^*K$, obtained by transposing the pullback of the counit through compact-support base change, is an isomorphism for every $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. At $K=A_S$ it gives $b:g'^*\omega_f\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{f'}$, where $\omega_f=f^\times A_S$. If $\phi_{f,K}:f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_f\to f^\times K$ denotes the canonical tensor map of [thm-asd-smooth-tensor], then
$$\beta_{f,g,K}\circ g'^*\phi_{f,K}=\phi_{f',g^*K}\circ(1\otimes b)$$
after identifying $g'^*(f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_f)$ with $f'^*g^*K\otimes_A^Lg'^*\omega_f$. The derived tensor is the ringed-site tensor construction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] applied to the constant ring on the etale site.

proof.text: Identify smoothExceptionalBaseChangeMap with the component of the existing upstream rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap. The elementary mate_app_eq follows by injectivity of the adjunction hom equivalence and mateEquiv_counit. Build HasInvertibleExponent from the given stalkwise units and pull it back along f. Apply the already stated isIso_rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.SmoothDuality), which realizes the isomorphism clause of this same blueprint node. This is a reuse of an existing declaration, with no new assumption or hole. The dualizing comparison is its component at the coefficient unit followed by the inverse-image unit isomorphism. For the compatibility bridge isIso_rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_general, apply lem-asd-exceptional-base-change-affine-locality. On each affine base chart, smoothness of relative dimension d is inherited by pullback and the invertible coefficient exponent pulls back along a. The affine base is quasi-separated, so apply the existing source-library theorem from SmoothDuality.SmoothBaseChange to that local square. This proves the general-base bridge from the separate open-restriction coherence theorem, without assuming quasi-separatedness of the original base. The original canonical-map identification and tensor steps remain as above.

Apply the existing projectionMap_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap and the generic Adjunction.projectionTensorMap_mateEquiv to obtain exceptional_tensor_base_change. Specialize its first tensor factor to the coefficient unit. Naturality of the tensor mate and leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_leftUnitor_hom give dualizing_tensor_base_change. The helper unit_tensor_base_change proves this specialization directly by naturality, functoriality and the interchange laws.

Express smoothTensorDualityMap as the braiding followed by dualizingComplexTensorMap, using braided_tensor_mate. Apply braided_tensor_square to dualizing_tensor_base_change and leftDerivedUpperStar_map_braiding_hom_δ. Expand only the canonical tensor functor, pullback-square isomorphism, unit comparison and their composites. The resulting equality is exactly the tensor clause of smooth_exceptional_base_change. All helpers are proved; no split theorem is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Canonical mate and final tensor square; existing upstream SmoothDuality supplies the isomorphism clause; projection exchange and monoidal unit/braiding coherence supply the tensor clause. The general-base compatibility bridge is reduced by P2 to affine-base smooth base change and the separate open-restriction coherence lemma.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be as in
[thm-asd-smooth-tensor], and let $g:S'\to S$
be any morphism of Noetherian schemes. Denote its base
change by $f':X'\to S'$, with $g':X'\to X$.
The canonical morphism

$$
g'^*f^\times K\longrightarrow f'^\times g^*K
$$

is an isomorphism for every complex $K$. At $K=A$
it identifies $g'^*\omega_f$ with $\omega_{f'}$,
and it respects the tensor isomorphism of
[thm-asd-smooth-tensor].

proof.text:
Proper base change on a compactification, followed by the
stalkwise base-change identity for extension by zero, gives
$Rf'_!g'^*\cong g^*Rf_!$, for bounded-below complexes by the
finite-amplitude argument in
[lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection]. Define the
displayed map by the adjunction of
[thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], transposing

$$
Rf'_!g'^*f^\times K\cong g^*Rf_!f^\times K
\longrightarrow g^*K.
$$

For a projective-line projection its unit and counit are
those explicitly constructed in
[thm-amb-p1-adjunction]. Both commute with base change:
the supported diagonal class does so by
[lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map], and the trace does so
by [thm-amb-p1-decomposition]. Hence the displayed
map in that case is the ordinary inverse-image and twist
base-change isomorphism. The same holds for an affine-line
projection by restricting its projective compactification,
and for affine space by composing those adjunctions.

It remains to verify the three coherences on which the identification
rests; each is a statement about the canonical maps, not merely about
their sources and targets.
*(i) The underlying base-change map in the model case.*
For the affine-space projection $\mathbf A^d_{S_0}\to S_0$
over a Zariski open $S_0\subseteq S$, the identification
$Rf'_!g'^*\cong g^*Rf_!$ of the first paragraph is the composite of
proper base change for the compactification
$\mathbf A^d\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^d$ with the stalkwise identity
$g^*j_!=j'_!g'^*$ for the extension by zero; both are comparisons of
the two diagrams obtained by base changing one diagram along $g$,
so the composite restricts to the chart $S'_0=S'\times_SS_0$.
*(ii) Unit and counit on the chart.* There the adjunction of
[thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] is the affine-space adjunction
[cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction], whose unit and counit are built
from the trace and the supported diagonal class; these commute with
base change by [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map] and
[thm-amb-p1-decomposition]. The displayed map is the transpose of
the counit composite, so the base-change isomorphism of (i) carries it
to the corresponding transpose over $S'_0$, which is the map defined
by the same recipe there.
*(iii) Descent to $X'$.* On the etale chart of $f$ used in
the proof of [thm-asd-smooth-tensor],
[lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality] identifies the map under
consideration with the base-change isomorphism of (ii) preceded by
etale inverse image, the sum over the finite fibre commuting with base
change; it is therefore an isomorphism on an etale cover of $X'$,
hence everywhere. Finally the tensor maps of
[thm-asd-smooth-tensor] were transposed from the projection
formula and the counit, and applying the same transposition to the
commuting base-change diagram of those two maps gives their base-change
compatibility. This proves all the claimed identifications.
